metadata.name: MiniMax-M3
metadata.variant_policy: One native text/image/video checkpoint with enabled/adaptive/disabled thinking modes; MXFP8 is separately packaged and outside this record.

attention.layer_pattern: First 3 layers use dense GQA; layers 3–59 (zero-indexed) use MSA on GQA (sparse_attention_freq).

sparse_attention.selection: Lightweight Index Branch max-pools token scores into blocks, independently selects top-k blocks per GQA group; always includes the local block. Main Branch performs exact softmax attention over selected blocks (MSA report §3).
sparse_attention.training_recipe: MSA mechanism: KL alignment of index distribution with group-averaged Main Branch distribution, stop-gradient at index inputs; dense-indexer warmup then sparse training. Production M3 stage/token budget is not disclosed.
sparse_attention.notes: Pinned production config: sparse_topk_blocks=16, sparse_block_size=128, sparse_score_type=max, sparse_local_block=1, sparse_init_block=0. This is a BLOCK budget, not 16 individual KV tokens; at most 2048 token slots per group before causal masking. No KV compression ratio is asserted.

attention.notes: Pinned config: rotary_dim=64 of head_dim=128; RoPE applies to half of each attention head. Per-head QK normalization (qk_norm_type=per_head); use_gemma_norm=true; attention_output_gate=false.

moe.routing: Sigmoid top-4 routing over 128 local experts with routing bias and routed_scaling_factor=2.0; one shared expert, shared_intermediate_size=3072 (config).

ffn.layer_partition: First 3 layers dense (moe_layer_freq=0), remaining 57 layers MoE; dense_intermediate_size=12288, routed expert intermediate_size=3072, shared expert intermediate_size=3072.

components.activation: swigluoai (config), alpha=1.702, limit=7.0; precise clamp formula not inferred from identifier alone.
components.normalization: RMSNorm epsilon=1e-6; use_gemma_norm=true; per-head QK normalization (config).

auxiliary_modules.name: Configured MTP modules
auxiliary_modules.architecture: text_config.num_mtp_modules=7 and num_nextn_predict_layers=1; mapping between module count and prediction horizon is not documented in the registered sources.

other: Native mixed text/image/video training from the first step (model card); detailed production losses and weights undisclosed.

inference_modes.name: enabled
inference_modes.trigger: API thinking=enabled; local chat template thinking_mode=enabled.
inference_modes.description: Always reason, including after tool results; local generation prefix <mm:think>.

inference_modes.name: adaptive
inference_modes.trigger: API thinking=adaptive; local chat template thinking_mode=adaptive.
inference_modes.description: Model decides whether to reason; local template default when thinking_mode is absent.

inference_modes.name: disabled
inference_modes.trigger: API thinking=disabled; local chat template thinking_mode=disabled.

tool_call_protocol.arguments_schema: Namespace prefix ]<]minimax[>[ before XML elements; <invoke name="FUNCTION"> with argument-name elements. Recursive XML expansion for nested mappings and arrays; null-valued mappings omitted.
tool_call_protocol.notes: New wire format differs from M2 <parameter name=...>; reasoning markers <mm:think>...</mm:think>. Pinned template renders reasoning for all assistant turns.

multimodal.fusion_notes: Model card states mixed-modality training from the first step. Vision features are projected into the 6144-wide text stream; native training does not imply absence of a vision encoder/projector.

vision_encoder.notes: image_size=2016; vision_segment_max_frames=4; patch_merge compression; vision RoPE base 10000, mode 3d (config). Pretrained initialization source not disclosed.

open_questions: MSA paper experiments use a 109B MoE and 3T-token budget; these do not disclose production M3 (~428B, ~23B active) training tokens, optimizer, schedule or post-training pipeline.
MSA typed top_k remains UNKNOWN because the config defines 16 blocks ×128 tokens, while schema field describes KV-entry count. Block count/size recorded explicitly in sparse_attention.notes.
MTP config has num_mtp_modules=7 and num_nextn_predict_layers=1. Exact objective depth, horizon, loss weight and public weight shipment require further vendor/code evidence.
MiniMax M3.1 Flash (October 19) is a later API release with weights promised later; it is not the M3 checkpoint or an open-weight update in this snapshot.
Unknown fields are deliberate; no optimizer, token mixture, full training precision or version deltas are inherited from neighboring checkpoints without source attribution.
